novelty_method: Immediate-neighbor semantic review of Ilyra's twenty frozen proposals and successor recommendation bank, with the inherited 3630-row commitment treated as immutable. The phase does not scan unchanged history and awards no novelty or completion credit to selected inherited rows.
selection_credit: The twenty Ilyra contracts are selected for literal preservation and earn zero Auren novelty or automatic completion credit.

selected_inherited.description: Preserve declared decompression-budget refusal without claiming real decoder or extraction assurance.
Preserve sparse logical-versus-stored size separation without materializing sparse files.
Preserve archive link-metadata refusal without claiming exhaustive archive safety.
Preserve UNC and extended Windows path refusal without claiming platform completeness.
Preserve bounded URI member-reference percent normalization without dereference.
Preserve JSON number lexical-boundary refusal without claiming complete parser conformance.
Preserve nonfinite and negative-zero schema refusal without scientific or numerical validation.
Preserve content-type allowlist quarantine without implying content safety.
Preserve attestation subject-digest agreement as bounded shape evidence only.
Preserve DSSE pre-authentication encoding vectors without signing or verification claims.
Preserve in-toto predicate-version reservation without provenance truth.
Preserve wall-clock rollback and monotonic-duration separation without trusted-time claims.
Preserve RFC 3339 offset normalization as a bounded lexical contract only.
Preserve duplicate JSON Pointer target refusal without complete JSON Pointer conformance.
Preserve the GMUT causal-support and boundary-condition board as symbolic representation only.
Preserve synthetic THOS museum condition and custody handover without professional authority.
Preserve the Freed ID evidence-receipt minimization profile without real identity or trust evidence.
Preserve alternative-format structure while affected-user accessibility evaluation remains absent.
Preserve the zero-row GWTC-5.0 adapter and the absence of empirical or independent reproduction evidence.
Preserve every museum access, treatment, return, remedy, legal, cultural, and Maori-authority reservation.

new_proposals.title: Declared binary byte-order receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic binary-layout metadata can require an explicit standard byte order before any record is interpreted.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An absent, native, ambiguous, or unsupported byte-order declaration passes, or the check is described as a complete binary parser.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every absent, native, or unsupported declaration fails and explicit little, big, or network order passes without unpacking bytes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the declaration, retain the metadata, and interpret no binary value.

new_proposals.title: Deterministic permission-mask normalization
new_proposals.hypothesis: A symbolic permission value can be normalized against an exact local bit mask without touching a filesystem.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A Boolean, negative, non-integer, or out-of-mask value passes, or normalization mutates real permissions.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only nonnegative integers wholly contained by the declared mask pass and the result is deterministic.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the value and perform no chmod, ACL, ownership, or filesystem operation.

new_proposals.title: Nested resource-budget aggregation
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic nested resource declarations can be summed under exact depth, member, and total ceilings before allocation.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Negative sizes, excessive depth, excessive members, or totals beyond budget pass, or the check allocates declared resources.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every negative, too-deep, too-many, or over-total declaration fails before allocation and one bounded declaration passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the declaration and allocate no resource.

new_proposals.title: Overflow-safe size multiplication
new_proposals.hypothesis: Two declared nonnegative dimensions can be multiplied only when their product fits an exact configured ceiling.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Negative, Boolean, non-integer, or overflow-prone factors pass, or product checks allocate memory.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Invalid factors and products over the ceiling fail; a bounded product returns exactly without allocation.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the declaration and retain both factors for review.

new_proposals.title: URI query and fragment component refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic repository member reference can refuse scheme, authority, query, fragment, encoded separator, and traversal components without dereference.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A forbidden component passes, normalization changes semantic structure, or any URI is dereferenced.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every forbidden component fails and one relative unreserved reference passes without network, filesystem, or package access.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the raw reference and make no external request.

new_proposals.title: Media-type parameter parsing and quarantine
new_proposals.hypothesis: A small declared media type can be parsed into a lower-case type and bounded unique parameters under a closed local policy.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Malformed tokens, duplicate parameters, unsupported charset, or excess parameters pass, or allowlisting implies content safety.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Malformed, duplicate, unsupported, or excessive parameters fail and one bounded declaration normalizes deterministically without opening content.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the declaration and inspect no content.

new_proposals.title: Multi-algorithm digest-policy reservation
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic digest maps can be checked against an exact ordered policy that distinguishes required, allowed, and reserved algorithms.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Unknown, missing, duplicate-by-case, malformed, or disallowed algorithms pass, or a shape check is called cryptographic agility.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only exact required and allowed lower-case algorithm names with fixed-length hexadecimal values pass; reserved algorithms remain refused.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the map and perform no digest computation or signature verification.

new_proposals.title: DSSE payload-type ASCII and Unicode boundary
new_proposals.hypothesis: A declared DSSE payload type can be limited to a short visible-ASCII token before PAE or signing surfaces are considered.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Empty, control, whitespace, non-ASCII, or excessive payload types pass, or validation implies DSSE signature validity.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every empty, control-bearing, non-ASCII, or overlong value fails and one bounded visible-ASCII type passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the envelope metadata and sign or verify nothing.

new_proposals.title: Attestation subject-name collision review
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic attestation subject names can be required to be unique under exact Unicode normalization and case-fold comparison.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Empty, control-bearing, normalization-colliding, or case-fold-colliding names pass, or uniqueness implies subject identity truth.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every empty, control-bearing, or normalized collision fails and distinct bounded names pass without resolving any identity.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the subject list and resolve no external object.

new_proposals.title: Leap-second reservation and refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded RFC 3339 lexical check can reserve second 60 rather than silently normalize it into ordinary time.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A leap-second declaration is silently accepted or changed, malformed offsets pass, or lexical validation implies trusted time.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Second 60 is returned as reserved and refused by default, malformed values fail, and one ordinary explicit-offset value passes without reading a clock.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the original lexical value and request exact external policy if leap-second handling is required.

new_proposals.title: JSON Pointer array-index lexical bounds
new_proposals.hypothesis: A decoded JSON Pointer token intended as an array index can be limited to canonical decimal syntax and an exact maximum.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Empty, signed, leading-zero, non-decimal, dash, or over-maximum indices pass, or validation traverses real JSON.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only zero or nonzero canonical decimals within the maximum pass; no JSON document is traversed.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the token and retain the pointer for review.

new_proposals.title: Alternative-format report revision parity
new_proposals.hypothesis: Two synthetic report descriptors can require exact record-set, schema-revision, and content-revision parity without claiming accessibility equivalence.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Mismatched identifiers or revisions pass, or structural parity is called complete accessibility.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only exact bounded parity passes; manual, assistive-technology, browser, language, cognitive, and affected-user evaluation remains reserved.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the stale format and preserve both revision descriptors.

new_proposals.title: Condition-term glossary versioning
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic condition terms can require a declared glossary identifier and revision before bounded handover use.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Empty terms, missing glossary identity, revision mismatch, or normalized collision passes, or the glossary is called professionally authoritative.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: A bounded term passes only with exact glossary and revision declarations and no normalized collision.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the term and request competent human review before any real use.

new_proposals.title: Custody-transition conflict quarantine
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic custody transitions can require exact prior state, next state, revision, hold status, and actor-label consistency before a bounded handover record is accepted.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Self-transition, stale revision, active hold, conflicting actor label, or forbidden state edge passes, or the check is called real custody authority.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only an allowed synthetic edge with the exact expected revision, no active hold, and distinct bounded actor labels passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the transition and preserve both conflicting declarations for competent review.

new_proposals.title: GMUT declared unit-system compatibility and boundary matrix
new_proposals.hypothesis: A symbolic matrix can expose unit-system declarations, dimensions, frames, approximation domains, conversions, provenance, and falsifiers without evaluating physics.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: The matrix is called an observed force, prediction, likelihood, parameter constraint, ultraviolet completion, Theory of Everything, or scientific authority.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The board remains symbolic and every empirical, predictive, completion, and scientific-authority conclusion remains false.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove any promotional language and retain only typed declarations and falsifiers.

new_proposals.title: THOS treatment-hold expiry and custody handover proxy
new_proposals.hypothesis: Fictional object records can represent hold start, declared expiry, condition term revision, custody conflict, correction readback, and shift acceptance under bounded state transitions.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Any real object, worker, institution, incident, treatment, custody action, or effectiveness claim enters the packet.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every identifier and event remains fictional and no employment, competence, treatment, return-to-service, custody, legal, cultural, or Maori-authority claim appears.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Delete any real-world datum and stop before any operational decision.

new_proposals.title: Freed ID external trust-policy change-control packet
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic receipts can separate digest policy, payload type, predicate version, disclosure, status, recovery, and verifier-policy revision without creating trust.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A real identity, key, credential, account, issuer, holder, verifier, signature, authorization, or trust decision is introduced.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The packet remains structural and synthetic; identity, cryptographic validity, trust, privacy approval, and production interoperability remain unproved.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove any real credential or identifier and require competent external trust governance.

new_proposals.title: CBR accessibility and cultural-care terminology review reservations
new_proposals.hypothesis: A reservation matrix can expose alternative-format parity, terminology revision, cultural-care review, privacy, remedy, and affected-party needs without deciding them.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Structural checks are called accessibility complete, culturally legitimate, legally approved, affected-party approved, or Maori-authority approved.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All manual, assistive-technology, language, cultural, legal, affected-party, and Maori-authority decisions remain reserved externally.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Remove any approval language and stop before a real decision or publication.

new_proposals.title: GWTC-5.0 zero-row source checksum and status-drift adapter
new_proposals.hypothesis: An adapter contract can represent source URL, release label, checksum field, retrieval status, row count, and drift status while retrieving zero bytes and zero rows.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Any network request, download, dataset row, likelihood, posterior, parameter constraint, observed force, or empirical conclusion is produced.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain open_gap until independent authorized people preregister, retrieve, checksum, analyze, and reproduce real evidence outside this same-owner lane.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep retrieval disabled and preserve the open gap.

new_proposals.title: Museum access, treatment, return, remedy, and authority matrix
new_proposals.hypothesis: A reservation matrix can make access, terminology, treatment, movement, custody, return, repatriation, privacy, remedy, legal, cultural, affected-party, data-governance, and Maori-authority questions visible without deciding them.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Repository software makes or implies a real access, terminology, treatment, return, repatriation, remedy, legal, cultural, governance, affected-party, or Maori-authority decision.
primary_source_needs: tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori authorities
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Remain exact_gate; every real decision and legitimacy claim stays with competent authorities and affected people.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before any real record, object, terminology, treatment, remedy, or authority action.

boundary: This immutable x1 freeze is planning evidence only. It does not implement x2, close any gate, validate a final commit, deliver a baton, or authorize Stage 20.
